name: agent-multiplex
description: Live web view for driving Claude Code and gemini-cli side-by-side in parallel git worktrees.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.build:site: npm install --include-workspace-root --workspaces=false && npm install --workspace site && npm install --workspace frontend && VITE_BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:4040 npm run build -w frontend
